lean.statement:
∀ {ι : Type u} {Ω : Type v} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [MeasurableSpace Ω]
  {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ],
  ∀ (f : Ω → Matrix ι ι ℝ), Integrable f μ →
    (∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (f ω).PosDef) → (∫ ω, f ω ∂μ).PosDef
approved_definition_context: Matrix ι ι ℝ is the finite real square-matrix algebra; Fintype supplies a finite enumeration and DecidableEq equality decisions. No Nonempty typeclass is present.
A.PosDef denotes a Hermitian real matrix whose quadratic form is strictly positive on each nonzero vector. Over ℝ Hermitian means transpose equality.

Measure Ω is a measure on the given measurable space. IsProbabilityMeasure means total mass one. Integrable f μ is Bochner integrability of the displayed matrix-valued function, and ∫ω,f ω∂μ is its Bochner integral under precisely μ.
∀ᵐω∂μ means for μ-almost every ω. Type universes u and v permit independent index and outcome types.
